faq.question: What is JSONL?
faq.answer: JSONL (JSON Lines) is a format where each line is a separate, complete JSON value. It is also called NDJSON. Because every line is independent, you can read or process one record at a time.

faq.question: How does JSON to JSONL conversion work?
faq.answer: The input JSON is parsed. If it is an array, every element is serialized onto its own line. If it is a single object or value, it becomes a single line. The joined lines form the JSONL output.

faq.question: Is JSONL the same as NDJSON?
faq.answer: Yes. JSONL and NDJSON describe the same line-delimited JSON format. This tool produces output that works for both names.

faq.question: Can I convert a single object?
faq.answer: Yes. A single JSON object or value becomes a single line of JSONL. Wrap multiple records in an array to produce multiple lines.

faq.question: What if my JSON is invalid?
faq.answer: The input is parsed before conversion. If it is not valid JSON, the tool reports an error instead of producing a partial or malformed JSONL file.

faq.question: Is this a free JSON to JSONL converter?
faq.answer: Yes. You can convert JSON to JSON Lines, copy the result, or download it as a .jsonl file without creating an account.

article.title: How to Convert JSON to JSONL Online
article.content:
What Is JSONL?

JSONL, also called JSON Lines or NDJSON, stores data as one JSON value per line. A JSON to NDJSON conversion puts each record on its own line; this NDJSON converter produces output that works under both names. Each line is a complete, independent record, which makes the format easy to stream, append to logs, or process line by line.

How to Convert JSON to JSONL

  1. Enter JSON: paste a JSON array (or a single value) into the input.
  2. Convert: the tool parses the JSON and writes one value per line.
  3. Use the output: copy the JSON Lines or download it as a .jsonl file.

When to Use JSON Lines

  • Logging: append one JSON record per line to a log file.
  • Streaming: read or write records one at a time without loading everything into memory.
  • Data pipelines: many big-data tools accept JSONL as input.
  • Bulk storage: store records in a line-delimited file that is easy to split.

JSON vs JSONL

A standard JSON array keeps all records inside one pair of brackets. JSONL puts each record on its own line. JSONL is better when you need to stream or append; a single JSON array is better when you need the whole collection as one object.

Privacy

Conversion runs entirely in your browser. Your JSON is not uploaded and no account is required. Do not paste passwords, tokens, or production credentials into any online tool.

article.title: 如何在线把 JSON 转为 JSONL
article.content:
什么是 JSONL？

JSONL，也叫 JSON Lines 或 NDJSON，把数据存成每行一个 JSON 值。json 转 ndjson（也就是 json 转 json lines）会把每条记录放到独立的一行；这个 ndjson 转换器生成的输出对这两个名称都适用。每一行都是一条完整、独立的记录，因此这种格式很容易流式传输、追加到日志，或逐行处理。

如何把 JSON 转为 JSONL

  1. 输入 JSON：把 JSON 数组（或单个值）粘贴到输入框。
  2. 转换：工具解析 JSON，并每行写一个值。
  3. 使用输出：复制 JSON Lines，或把它下载成 .jsonl 文件。

什么时候用 JSON Lines

  • 日志：向日志文件逐行追加一条 JSON 记录。
  • 流式处理：逐条读写记录，而不必一次性全部载入内存。
  • 数据管道：很多大数据工具都以 JSONL 作为输入。
  • 批量存储：用按行分隔的文件保存记录，便于切分。

JSON 与 JSONL 的区别

标准 JSON 数组把所有记录放在同一对括号里；JSONL 把每条记录放在独立的一行。需要流式或追加时 JSONL 更合适；需要把整批数据作为单个对象时，标准 JSON 数组更合适。

隐私

转换完全在你的浏览器中运行，JSON 不会被上传，也不需要账号。请勿在任何在线工具里粘贴密码、令牌或生产环境凭据。
